owner_and_source: Federal Transit Administration (FTA), National Transit Database -- 'General Transit Feed Specification Weblinks', dataset 2u7n-ub22 on data.transportation.gov (the LIVE monthly-refreshed weblinks table, which the report-year snapshot venb-5asu explicitly defers to). No API key, no registration.
license_and_commercial_rights: Public Domain U.S. Government (portal licenceId=USGOV_WORKS, termsLink https://www.usa.gov/government-works; DCAT Common Core License http://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/). A federal government work, not subject to domestic copyright (17 U.S.C. Sec. 105). COMMERCIAL USE IS PERMITTED without restriction. NOTE THE SCOPE LIMIT: this public-domain grant covers the LIST of weblinks, not the agency GTFS feeds the links point at. Each agency feed carries its own terms and needs its own manifest before any of its bytes enter the estate.
geography: United States, nationwide -- every NTD reporter with a fixed-route mode
time_coverage: current register (refreshed monthly); each row carries its own Date Validated and Modified Date
schema_and_format: CSV, ~1,539 data rows x 20 columns: NTD ID, Agency Name, City, State, Organization Type, Reporter Type, Agency VOMS, Mode Name, Mode, TOS, Mode VOMS, UACE Code, UZA Name, Primary UZA Population, Weblink, Weblink Justification, Waived, Certification Flag, Date Validated, Modified Date. This is the JOIN KEY between the NTD ridership/service panels (which are keyed on NTD ID) and the agencies' published GTFS schedule feeds (which are keyed on nothing federal at all). Without it, linking a demand series to a schedule feed is manual guesswork.
update_frequency: monthly (portal Update Frequency R/P1M). source_checksum is null -- the register changes as agencies re-certify links.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- a feed registry, not observational or operational data. It is Connect-layer input: it tells themis.connect which agency feeds exist and where, before any adapter runs.

quality_tests.name: header_has_ntd_id_and_weblink
quality_tests.description: first line carries both an NTD ID column and a Weblink column -- the two fields that make it a usable join key

quality_tests.name: at_least_a_thousand_agencies_modes
quality_tests.description: more than 1,000 data rows, i.e. national coverage rather than a truncated page

acceptance_threshold: downloads, is CSV, > 100 KB, > 1,000 data rows, and the header contains both NTD ID and Weblink.
retention_and_deletion: retain: tiny and disproportionately load-bearing (it is the only federal NTD-ID-to-GTFS-feed mapping). Reproducible monthly; a fresher pull supersedes.
